title: docs(adr): ADR-0097 "Upstream availability" states the mcp credential-rejection carve-out (fatal configuration fault, never retried)

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:ADR-0097「Upstream availability」一节追加一条带日期的修订注(append-only):MCP 服务器**拒收凭据**(connect / handshake / `tools/list` 收到 HTTP 401 / 403)是**配置错误**——启动即失败、reload 时跳过、不重试;原句不改。文件头 `**Amended by**` 行同步补一条目。
- **为什么改**:PR #26798(#26709 第 3(b) 项)已让 `mcp` provider 这样分类,但 ADR 原句仍说「所有 connect / `tools/list` 失败都归为 unavailable(降级重试)」。读 ADR 的 agent / 运维会得出「凭据错了会自动重试」的错误结论,而运行时实际直接拒绝启动。
- **风险与回滚**:仅 `docs/adr/0097-declarative-connector-instances.md` 一个文件、+20/-1 行,不发布、无 changeset。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**:`docs/adr/0097-declarative-connector-instances.md` 的修订注(「Upstream availability」节 `mcp` 段落之后),再看第 8 行 `**Amended by**` 新条目。
- **两分钟验证**:`pnpm check:adr-symbol-anchors && pnpm check:adr-index`,预期两者绿;`git grep -n "classifies connect" -- docs/adr/0097*` 仍恰好 1 处(原句未动)。
- **需要你做的**:批准本 PR(`docs/adr/**` 受管面 Tier H,席位不 ready / 不 arm / 不入队)。

## What changes

One file, `docs/adr/0097-declarative-connector-instances.md`:

- **A dated, append-only amendment note** under "Upstream availability: degrade, don't die", directly after the paragraph that says the `mcp` provider classifies connect / `tools/list` failures as unavailable. The note states the one exception past transport validation: a credential the MCP server rejects (HTTP 401 / 403 on connect, handshake or `tools/list`) is a configuration fault, thrown plain — fatal at boot, a skipped entry on reload, never `CONNECTOR_UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE`, never retried — on the fatal side of the section's own split beside an unresolvable `credentialRef` and the `openapi` provider's non-retryable `4xx` on its spec fetch. It says why (retrying cannot make a wrong, missing or under-scoped credential valid; a degraded instance retried with backoff reads as "server down") and how the rejection is told apart (the MCP SDK's own `StreamableHTTPError` 401 / 403 or `UnauthorizedError` in the `cause` chain; a JSON-RPC error merely carrying code 401 stays operational). The original sentence is **not rewritten** (AGENTS.md Prime Directive 13).
- **A second entry on the header's existing `**Amended by**` line** pointing at that note, so a reader of the header learns where the record was amended, as it already does for ADR-0143.

Every claim in the note is read off `origin/main`, not invented: the classification and its reason from `packages/connectors/connector-mcp/src/mcp-provider.ts#credentialRejectionStatus` and `#createMcpProviderFactory` (the catch branch and its docblock), the "skipped on reload" half from this ADR's own "Runtime reconcile" section, and the real-server pin from `packages/connectors/connector-mcp/src/mcp-http-discovery-faults.test.ts` (`credential rejection — real Streamable-HTTP server`: 401 and 403 throw plain and are sent once; a declarative instance answered 401 fails `kernel.bootstrap()` with no degraded reason and no retry).

Anchors are `path#symbol` as the ADR symbol-anchor gate requires (no `file:line`). The note cites #26709 item 3(b) and PR #26798 as the card asks.

## Tests

No code changes, no tests added or edited. No forced test edits.

## Acceptance notes

- The card body asks for the note to cite "#26709 item 3(b) and the PR"; the note's heading carries both, matching this file's existing `Amendment note (date, source)` convention and ADR-0092 / ADR-0099's non-ADR amendment notes.
- The card delta asked for "the Status-line `Amended` entry if the file's convention has one". This file's convention is the `**Amended by**:` header line (ADR-0005 carries several comma-separated entries there); the `**Status**:` line itself is untouched, so `check:adr-index` still reads the record as `Accepted` (the index reads the status keyword earliest in that line, and `Amended` is in its vocabulary — adding it to the Status line could have re-keyed the record).
- `skills/**` is not touched: no skill page teaches the `openapi` or `mcp` provider (PR #26798's body measured 0 hits for the provider spellings under `skills/`), so no skill text owes a mirror of this note.
- Not published (`docs/adr/**` is on the changeset fast lane): no changeset; `skip-changeset` is declared on the `pr_create` stroke.
